descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S03b 「养老院：同样的编辑、Copy 和发送；同事读到的正好是编辑后的养老院交接」 Nursing Home: the same edit, Copy and send; the colleague reads exactly the edited Nursing Home handoff

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 The sending physician can edit the generated handoff before sending, and the recipient, retrieving it from their own account, sees exactly the edited text.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U9 A 'Copy' button copies the current handoff text, including any edits, to the clipboard, the same as 'Copy to EMR' on the note; copying stays on the device and nothing is emailed or shared.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U3 Hospital and Nursing Home use the same handoff structure and delivery; there is no separate Nursing Home format (and no data from the other context).（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 3；UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Sender with the S02 census; a seeded @roundai.test recipient with their own browser session

When Sender switches to Nursing Home, opens Handoff → Send to…; deletes every line containing 'pain > 6', replaces every 'ORIF' with 'QA-CHG-arthroplasty' (the header line included) and adds the last line 'QA-EDIT-NH4K recheck incision Thursday'; taps the dialog's Copy; sends (Skip on the follow-up question); …

Then As S03a for Nursing Home: the same delivery and record, the edited text exactly as sent, no Hospital patient, no email or share control. Whether the sheet's Copy Text carries the edit is recorded for Q6

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：As S03a; unit lines ('| Unit Cedar 12' …) play the room lines' part

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S03b 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
